title: Eval Signal Harmonizer: unified quality-index service for quantization calibration and validation
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Build a lightweight service and scoring abstraction ("Eval Signal Harmonizer") that ingests raw outputs and eval traces from the calibration/eval harness and emits normalized quality signals usable by gating/orchestrator for FP8/INT8 profiles. Goals: 1) provide consistent, comparable metrics across model variants (full precision, fp8, int8) and tasks; 2) support perplexity, MMLU-style aggregated accuracy, BLEU/ROUGE for generative tasks, and pluggable task-specific scorers; 3) expose confidence intervals and statistical tests to inform gating decisions and rollouts; 4) integrate with existing eval harness, dashboarding, and the calibration pipeline for automated acceptance checks.
comments: 2025-02-10 - Asha K: Rough spec drafted. Problem: current eval outputs are heterogeneous (different scorer formats, label schemas). Need normalization layer and canonical metric contracts.
2025-02-11 - Liam O: Proposal to use a 3-stage pipeline: ingest ->normalize/score -> aggregate/index. Will prototype aggregator as a thin HTTP service with plugin hooks for scorers.
2025-02-12 - PM review (R. Singh): Prioritize MMLU and perplexity first for model gating; BLEU/ROUGE next sprint. Add requirements for CI-friendly outputs (JSONL with schema v1).
2025-02-13 - Design feedback (Maya Chen): Visualize per-task deltas and bootstrap CI. Recommend visual delta heatmap and histogram for distributional shifts.

2025-02-14 - Engineering note: Implemented local prototype for perplexity normalization (log-perplexity -> percentile per-task). Observed larger variance on long-form evals; need stratified bootstrapping.
2025-02-15 - Security: No secrets in metrics payloads. Ensure identifiers are hashed for PII-sensitive evals. Marked as non-blocking.

2025-02-16 - Liam O: Uploaded prototype repo and PR link. Early results: int8 profile shows 1.7% drop on MMLU aggregate vs fp32; bootstrap CI overlaps in 40% of tasks. Suggest per-task gating thresholds and weighted aggregate.

2025-02-17 - PM decision: Use hybrid gating rule - require (a) weighted-aggregate delta within tolerance AND (b) no task with delta > per-task-failure-threshold. Create follow-up to tune weights per customer workload class.

2025-02-18 - Next steps: finalize metric contracts, add BLEU/ROUGE plugin, integrate with calibration orchestration to auto-block rollout when CI fails; instrument dashboards for alerting. Blocker: finalize schema for scorer plugins (open decision: protoc vs JSON Schema).
